note: The shapes of the ID tokens tests/licence-service.mjs signs with its own test keys, standing in for Microsoft's and Google's (board 980, stage 1). Each claim is one its provider documents, read 2026-11-11; every value is invented (example GUIDs from Microsoft's own pages, example.com-style names) and signs nothing real. A leg overrides what it varies; `uti` and `at_hash` are drawn fresh per token.

microsoft.source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/id-token-claims-reference (updated 2026-06-15): header typ, alg, kid; v2.0 payload claims.
microsoft.keysDocument: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/access-tokens (updated 2026-07-17): common/discovery/v2.0/keys returns kty, use, kid, x5t, n, e, x5c and issuer per key, templated https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantid}/v2.0 or exact for the consumers tenant 9188040d-6c67-4c5b-b112-36a304b66dad.

google.source: https://developers.google.com/identity/openid-connect/openid-connect (read 2026-11-11): an ID token's payload; iss https://accounts.google.com or accounts.google.com; hd absent for an account outside a Google hosted domain.
google.keysDocument: the jwks_uri of https://accounts.google.com/.well-known/openid-configuration (https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/certs as the page shows it): keys with kty, alg RS256, use sig, kid, n, e.
